[Story]
Li Lei really likes to play basketball, but his skills are not very good. Li Lei's friends often invite him to play basketball after school. Lei's sister always mocks his basketball skills. He is now in his senior year of high school and his coursework is heavy. Today is the weekend, Li Lei's friend invites him to play basketball. When Lei's sister asks him, "Do you go to play basketball today?" Li Lei answers, "No."

[Question]
Why does Li Lei want to play basketball, but he says no?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Because he does not want his sister to mock him anymore.
B. Because he is in his senior year of high school and his coursework is heavy, he does not want to affect his studies by playing basketball.
C. Because he thinks basketball is not interesting.
D. Because he is afraid of being mocked by his friends.
